variants.no_kernel: Set all kernel weights to zero; retain metadata-prior smoothing and the frozen topic correction
variants.no_topic: Set the topic correction to zero; retain metadata-prior smoothing, Kernel Probe, and the frozen mixing weights

evidence: Record all variants in the paired evaluator using identical Adaptive acquisition prefixes and evaluation items
fitting: Inference-time component removal only; no refitting or retuning, including calibration
aggregation: Mean squared error within each group, equal group means within each seed, equal seed means; official six-budget ALC weights
validation: Full ASRP must reproduce every published adaptive prediction within 1e-7; component calculations are also checked against native predict with the corresponding component disabled
